# Open-Source Distribution Gate

This directory contains release tooling for the statically linked LGPL
components shipped by Taption Encoder. It is release source, not historical
proof.

The gate is intentionally fail-closed for technical release checks. A local
build, simulator test, device install, archive, TestFlight upload, or a passing
technical gate does not establish legal approval. Under the owner's instruction
on 2026-10-06, a separate external counsel approval record is not mandatory for
App Store upload/submission. License obligations remain unchanged.

## Technical inventory

- `libvlc-ios-provenance.json` pins the SwiftVLC package, libVLC source,
  downloaded binary, device archive digest, and FFmpeg configuration observed
  in that archive.
- `libvlc-ios-contrib-manifest.tsv` pins all 56 verified source archives used
  by the VideoLAN iOS contrib selection. The license column identifies exact
  upstream files to preserve; it is not a legal conclusion.
- `generate_libvlc_contrib_notices.sh` verifies every source digest and builds
  the in-app contrib notice from those upstream files.
- `prepare_open_source_source_bundle.sh` assembles a deterministic source-offer
  bundle from verified inputs.
- `prepare_relink_materials.sh` captures the release LinkFileList, Mach-O app
  objects, normalized linker command, and release dependency lock into a
  version-bound technical relinking candidate.
- `verify_public_distribution_gate.sh` requires a matching release archive,
  App Store distribution IPA, source bundle, relinking bundle, App Thinning
  report. It validates an external approval record only when explicitly requested.
- `LEGAL_REVIEW_PACKET.md` lists questions for an optional external review without
  collapsing engineering, App Store, and legal proof surfaces.
- `legal-approval.pending.json` is deliberately non-passing and may be copied
  into the external release record before an authorized reviewer completes it.

## Optional external record

By default, omit `--legal-approval`: all technical checks still run, and the gate
reports `LEGAL_REVIEW_STATUS=NOT_VERIFIED`. `PUBLIC_DISTRIBUTION_GATE=PASS` means
the technical checks passed, not that a lawyer approved the release or all legal
issues were resolved. Do not change a pending template to approved yourself.

If an actual external review is obtained, use `--legal-approval approval.json`.
This enables the original strict checks; a pending, incomplete, or mismatched
record still blocks. `--require-legal-approval` explicitly requires a record.
The approval JSON in that opt-in mode must contain:

```json
{
  "status": "approved",
  "approvalID": "external review record identifier",
  "reviewer": "Outside counsel or authorized reviewer",
  "approvedAt": "YYYY-MM-DD",
  "bundleIdentifier": "com.taption.encoder",
  "marketingVersion": "release version",
  "buildVersion": "release build",
  "sourceBundleSHA256": "64 lowercase hex characters",
  "relinkBundleSHA256": "64 lowercase hex characters",
  "appSizeReportSHA256": "64 lowercase hex characters",
  "distributionIPASHA256": "64 lowercase hex characters",
  "lgplStaticLinking": "approved",
  "appStoreEULACarveout": "approved",
  "libvlcContribMap": "approved",
  "hevcDistribution": "approved"
}
```

The relinking bundle must contain `RELINK_README.txt`, `LINK_COMMAND.txt`,
`SYSTEM_LINK_INPUTS.txt`, `Package.resolved`, `relink-metadata.json`,
`SHA256SUMS`, and `TaptionEncoder-AppObjects.tar.xz`. The object archive and
metadata object count must agree. Preservation and technical validation of these
materials do not resolve every license or platform term. Any external assessment
remains separate; no external approval is implied when the record is omitted.

The gate also validates an Apple Distribution-signed IPA and requires the
`App Thinning Size Report.txt` generated by an export of the same archive. It
enforces Apple's current iOS limits of 4 GB for the uncompressed app and 500 MB
for the total `__TEXT` segments in each Mach-O executable, then reports artifact
digests. In opt-in approval mode, those digests must also match the approval record.
See Apple's current limits at
https://developer.apple.com/help/app-store-connect/reference/app-uploads/maximum-build-file-sizes/.
